claims.claim: CBP has indefinitely suspended duty-free de minimis treatment in the postal network; the postal process requires HTSUS/duty data and Section 301 goods can require another entry type.
claims.counterevidence: other statutory exemptions exist but are not assumed for these commercial goods.

claims.claim: USTR extended 178 China Section 301 exclusions through 2026-11-10; no SKU here was mapped to a qualifying 10-digit HTS/exclusion.
claims.counterevidence: active exclusions do not automatically apply.

claims.claim: No SKU has a verified landed total under any of the four architectures; therefore verified savings n=0 in A, B and C.

claims.claim: SMZDM gives model-level hands-on evidence for 战戟5000 but does not independently prove the 4U unstrung variant or any price.

data_gaps: All four shipment architectures lack a complete real logistics/customs quote for every SKU.
Most CN ordinary current prices are unobservable logged out; page shells/snippets were not used as prices.
Per-SKU final 10-digit HTSUS, MFN/301/additional duty/exemption mapping and broker/entry charges are unresolved.
CN domestic shipping, agent fee, export package actual/volumetric weight, packaging/battery surcharge and international freight are largely missing.
ZIP10001 shipping is unobserved for SHEIN/Naturehike/Creality unless the public page explicitly says free US shipping; no login/checkout was used.
FX source is null because no verified landed total is computable; US state/local sales/use tax is excluded by design.
